prompt: Add a few solid unit tests for this one small function - edge cases, determinism, structure.
criteria: Activates writing-unit-tests-quick (compact rules for one function/fix)

prompt: Backfill unit tests for this legacy module: design the test doubles, review the whole suite's brittleness.
criteria: Activates writing-unit-tests (full form: legacy code, test-double design, suite review)

prompt: Build this new behavior test-first: red-green-refactor, outside-in across several units, with a cycle log.
criteria: Activates test-driven-development (full loop, multi-unit, cycle log)
notes: Multi-unit feature with TDD = full variant.

prompt: Write the failing test first for this one small bug fix, then make it pass.
criteria: Does not invoke the multi-unit cycle-log workflow
notes: One bug fix = quick variant, not the full TDD session.

prompt: We are leaving Cypress after four years: 340 specs, a pile of custom commands, and some all-skip leftovers from an earlier Protractor attempt. Port us to Playwright - staged slices with parity gates, not a big-bang rewrite.
criteria: Activates migrating-tests-to-playwright: staged plan, keep-vs-drop decisions, parity gate before any legacy spec is deleted
Names the parity gate explicitly - the old suite dies only after the gate passes
Keeps the twin command form out of the model's activation choice - it is the fixed user-run entry
notes: P17 twin pair: a natural-language migration request routes to the skill; the command stays user-run.

prompt: UI-401 failed in build #417, then passed on the retry - third Monday in a row. Find the root-cause class and fix it properly, and no, don't just raise the timeout.
criteria: Activates stabilizing-flaky-tests: classifies the failure (timing, shared state, data collision, order, environment, or a real race) instead of tuning timeouts
Proves the fix under the conditions that broke it; quarantine with owner and expiry only if the fix cannot land now
Treats 'raise the timeout' as a wrong fix, not a plan B
notes: P17 twin pair plus the timeout-as-fix anti-pattern in one trigger.
